It is not a claim that the page links no structured file at all (a real data file served with a generic label and no extension is missed), nor that the agency publishes no machine-readable data: data offered on another website, such as a data portal or an API, or reached only through a query tool, is outside this page's same-website links. |

| rf_partial | Some of the agency's data pages linked such a structured file and some did not. |
| rf_pass | A link on this data page, on the page's own website, returned a file that the server labeled by its media type, or the address named by its file extension, as a structured data format: CSV, JSON, XML, spreadsheet or Parquet. Every data page that was looked at met this. |

Avoid documents (PDFs) that need to be processed and parsed."}, {"source": "m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove", "quote": "data in a format that can be easily processed by a computer without human intervention"}, {"source": "m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove", "quote": "Agencies must make each of their public data assets machine-readable."}] |

| rf_where_we_look | On the agency's data page, and the files linked from that page that sit on the same website as the page itself. |
